scope: Reference-led refinement of an existing academic project homepage
primary_reference: User reference image 2 and Harness VLA source: Inter typography, editorial heading hierarchy, and generous academic spacing
secondary_references: User reference image 1: square scientific chart frame, restrained graph-paper texture, direct values
User reference image 3: wide media sequence with captions below each frame
decisions: Retained the existing GeoAAC color identity instead of copying another project's palette
Switched body typography from Manrope to the reference site's Inter stack and enlarged the hero hierarchy
Removed the section-heading accent rule at the user's request
Removed rounded rectangular styling while preserving circular play affordances
Rebuilt reported results as an interactive zero-based 0–100 percent horizontal profile with dataset, backbone, and metric controls
Included every paper-reported LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, and RoboCasa365 value in an accessible expandable table, with no invented error bars
Kept media slots visibly empty until genuine project assets are supplied
Added paper-grounded contributions and visible real-robot result captions
